doctrine: External protocol breadth enters through narrow adapters behind the immutable agent-tool manual. Discovery compiles bounded untrusted descriptions into typed candidate manuals; it never mutates the active catalog. Catalog search is deterministic and bound to exact manual identities. Streaming is a bounded, cancellable, sequenced lifecycle with an explicit terminal record. Model-authored tool workflows compile as closed-world recipe programs and execute without source generation or an embedded interpreter. Every row reuses artifact, recipe, operation, policy, and evidence owners already in the tree and deletes displaced switches, wrappers, caches, and temporary shapes in the same commit.

items.title: Admit typed steering proposals through deterministic validation

steps.title: Admit typed steering proposals through deterministic validation -- Typed proposal document: goal, predicted benefit, predicted cost, explicit uncertainty, falsifiable check, references into measurement history. Deterministic admission validates references and converts an admitted proposal into a plan row with the proposal as provenance; proposals never execute anything. Closes: model-proposed steering from accumulated evidence.

items.title: Close the loop: admitted proposals feed the driver under stop conditions

steps.title: Close the loop: admitted proposals feed the driver under stop conditions -- cmd/loop consumes admitted proposals when the plan drains instead of stopping, under stop conditions: invocation budget, saturation (no measured improvement across K consecutive experiments), and the explicit operator stop. Closes: the recursive policy-improvement loop.

items.title: Mutation-test the gate selector against injected defects

steps.title: Mutation-test the gate selector against injected defects -- Inject known defects into fixture packages and require the manifest selector to select the checks that catch them; extends the false-negative corpus into mutation coverage of the automation itself.
